prompts.desktop-direction-v1:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop game interface target for the existing Chinese cultivation game 尘缘问道, one complete 1440x900-style viewport, landscape 16:10.
Primary request: redesign the whole interaction hierarchy so the player immediately sees their current progress, the next useful action, its cost and its result, with substantially richer and more attractive game art.
Input image 1: aesthetic reference only for Chinese semi-realistic painting, warm paper, ink-jade and aged gold. Do not copy its old layout or bake the reference into the result. Create a new composition for the screen described below.
Scene: 听雨洞府, a quiet Chinese cultivator's cliffside cave retreat with rain beyond the eaves, a simple meditation mat, small alchemy furnace, bamboo and distant luminous mountains. Beautiful high-end hand-painted semi-realistic Chinese fantasy game environment, convincing depth, restrained warm lantern accents against rich jade-blue mist, detailed surfaces, confident lighting, no muddy grey wash. This is an early mortal chapter: no open heaven gate, floating god avatar, wings or late-game spectacle.
Layout: clean shippable game UI, slim branded topbar, compact left character/status column, dominant center scene and decision area, concise right next-goal column. Generous but purposeful spacing, clear readable Chinese labels, elegant restrained ornament, strong actionable button contrast. Center art is immersive but leaves the primary action fully visible in the same first viewport. A compact action card directly under the scene has one large jade-filled primary button, outlined secondary controls and small immediate cost/result chips. Do not create a long document or multiple equal beige boxes. Four clearly named navigation items form a compact bottom dock.
Text (verbatim), include only these short game labels and numbers: 尘缘问道; 听雨洞府; 已保存; 设置; 顾长青; 凡人; 气血 60/60; 灵力 20/20; 修为 0/10; 灵石 40; 当前目标; 引气入体; 修为尚缺10; 无需突破物; 自然吐纳; 修为 +5; 1游戏月; 不消耗灵石; 连续行动 1次; 灵石辅助; 需炼气; 洞府疗养; 状态已满; 近期收获; 修行; 历练; 行囊; 仙缘; 数值未平衡.
Character: one compact consistent youthful Chinese male cultivator portrait in simple ivory and teal travel robes, clear face, not a full-body fashion poster. No additional named people or invented game systems.
Constraints: primary 自然吐纳 button and its cost/result must be conspicuous without scrolling. Character XP and current goal visible. Use restrained decorative serif/calligraphic headings and highly readable body labels. Avoid walls of explanatory prose, oversized help boxes, fake badges, shopping/money monetization, chat panels, maps of new lands, English text, logos, watermarks and external brand UI. This is a design target image; final interactive text and controls will be built in DOM, not used as a flattened clickable screenshot. Render a polished visual rather than a diagram with annotations.
prompts.mobile-direction-v1:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity mobile game interface target for 尘缘问道, one complete tall portrait app viewport, approximately 390x844 proportions. Fill the canvas with the app itself: no phone hardware, no desktop frame, no multiple screens.
Input image 1: desktop-direction-v1, style and scene reference only. Adapt its excellent Chinese semi-realistic cave-retreat art, warm paper, deep ink-jade and restrained aged-gold accents to a genuinely mobile interaction layout; do not shrink the desktop columns.
Primary request: a much clearer and more attractive playable mobile cultivation screen. The player must see their current realm/progress, next goal, one primary action and its cost/result in this first viewport. Large readable Chinese labels and comfortable touch controls.
Scene: same early mortal 听雨洞府, rain-lit mountain cave retreat, meditation mat, warm alchemy furnace and misty Chinese peaks. Beautiful layered painting, no open heaven gate or late-game god spectacle. Keep a compact immersive scene in the upper half, not a full-height wallpaper.
Layout: slim top brand/save/settings row; compact character thumbnail and always-visible resource/progress strip; wide scene card; one concise next-goal line; a compact action card with a strong jade primary button and cost/result chips. Secondary actions are behind a clearly labeled 更多行动 control. Four equal navigation targets at the bottom. Main button stays clearly above the bottom navigation, all core text within this one viewport, no long tutorial panel or explanatory paragraphs. Body type should feel at least18-20 CSS pixels at390px, not miniature labels.
Text (verbatim): 尘缘问道; 已保存; 设置; 凡人; 气血60/60; 灵力20/20; 修为0/10; 灵石40; 听雨洞府; 当前目标; 引气入体; 尚缺10修为; 自然吐纳; 修为+5; 1游戏月; 不消耗灵石; 更多行动; 修行; 历练; 行囊; 仙缘; 数值未平衡.
Constraints: 0/10 progress is empty, never partially filled. No invented rewards, red notification dots, premium currency, chat/online systems, fake claim buttons, watermarks or extra character names. Do not copy the desktop's huge portrait column. Consistent calm semi-realistic Chinese fantasy aesthetic, polished and atmospheric but practical and readable. This is a design target; real app controls and text will be built in DOM.
